title: Cedar Bridge MedTech pilot scratchpad
body:
Quick notes / scratchpad for Cedar Bridge (regional medtech chain) pilot outreach and proposal

Context and why this looks interesting
- Cedar Bridge: midsize regional chain (30 clinics, 6 ambulatory surgical centers). Heavy EHR footprint (Cerner + a couple legacy integrations).
- Pain: clinician burnout from charting + triage message load. Want to trial LLM assistant for pre-visit summarization and message triage, but must be HIPAA-safe and auditable.
- Opportunity: pilot that keeps PHI inside Cedar network (private deployment) but uses Redwood control plane for rollouts and observability. Good showcase for Private (VPC) + optional on-prem agent later.

Account research quick hits (to verify before call)
- CTO: Dr. Sandeep Rao (strong infra background; wants clear risk matrix).
- Dir of Clinical Ops: Elaine Morris (owns workflow adoption, nurse triage).
- Security/compliance: VP InfoSec: Priya Anand (will demand BAA + pen test + KMS/HSM).
- Procurement contact: Ben Holloway (prefers fixed pilot SOW, limited PO).
- Current stack notes: Cerner Millenium, MS Teams for internal comms, Okta SSO, Azure AD tenant.
- Latency expectation: clinicians want <150ms tail for short summaries; asynchronous triage ok up to 1s.

Constraints we need to stress and verify
- PHI cannot leave Cedar's VPC without BAA and encryption at rest + in transit. Recommend Private deployment (customer-managed VPC) or Dedicated with strict routing.
- Data residency: all data must be stored in the us-east-1 region (Cedar has contracts requiring East coast).
- Auditability: must keep full request/response logs for 90 days; support for redaction on logs. Need to confirm Redwood retention config limits.
- Model explainability: clinical review team will want deterministic prompt templates and versioned model rollouts.

Pilot proposal (MVP scope — short and measurable)
- Duration: 8 weeks (4-week sandbox + 4-week live shadowing).
- Users: 5 clinicians (2 PCPs, 2 triage nurses, 1 clinic manager).
- Use-cases: 1) pre-visit note summarization (structured bullets), 2) inbound patient message triage (classify + suggest response drafts).
- Integration: lightweight webhook from Cerner message stream -> Redwood Private endpoint -> return structured JSON (summary, confidence, action tag).
- Success metrics (must be quantitative):
  - Time saved per chart: target 4–6 min reduction per visit note (measured by instrumented workflow sampling).
  - Triage accuracy: suggestion acceptance rate >= 70% after week 6.
  - Latency: 95th percentile < 800ms for triage; <150ms tail for on-screen summary rendering in clinician UI.
  - No PHI leakage incidents; audit log completeness = 100% for pilot windows.

Security / deployment recommendations to pre-empt objections
- Recommend: Private deployment (Redwood Private) inside Cedar VPC with KMS integration (customer-managed keys).
- Alternative: Dedicated reserved capacity with IP-restricted peering + strict egress rules.
- Logging: enable masked logging + ability to export logs to Cedar SIEM (Splunk).
- Pen test: offer partner-friendly timeline — we can provide environment for their 3rd-party pen test during sandbox (add clause to SOW).

Pre-call checklist (what I need to confirm before intro call)
- Get sample (synthetic or de-identified) message stream schema from Cerner team.
- Confirm Azure tenant & whether peering to us-east-1 is allowed.
- Ask Priya what specific encryption / KMS vendor they require (AWS KMS vs Azure Key Vault vs HSM).
- Draft BAA + SOW outline for pilot (finance will need a PO -- prepare two pricing options: fixed pilot fee vs usage+support).

Outbound sequence (cold>warm>demo request) — short drafts to iterate
Email 1 (intro):
Subject: Pilot to cut charting time at Cedar Bridge 
Hi Elaine —
Quick note: I work with medtech teams (Redwood Inference) building inference workflows that keep PHI inside customer networks while speeding charting and message triage. We’ve run 8–week pilots with similar clinics that reduced per-note time by 30–40% in shadow mode. Would you be open to a 20-min intro to explore a short sandbox?
—Marissa

Email 2 (probe to security):
Subject: HIPAA-first pilot design for Cedar Bridge
Hi Priya —
We design pilots to run inside customer VPCs with customer-managed KMS and retain audit logs to your SIEM. Happy to share a tailored BAA + security pack. Can I share a short checklist to align on controls?

LinkedIn note (to CTO):
Quick question — do you have a preferred model for pilot deployments (VPC vs dedicated)? We have a sample SOW and technical checklist that usually helps speed procurement.

Objections likely + crisp replies
- "We can't have any PHI leave our network" -> "We can run Redwood Private inside your VPC; no PHI egress unless you opt-in. Full BAA and KMS. Also can offer on-prem package if needed."
- "Too risky for clinical accuracy" -> "Pilot framing: shadow mode first, clinician-in-the-loop. Version pinning and rollback. We'll include guardrails, model/regression monitoring, and a prompt set curated with your clinical leads."
- "Procurement wants firm budget" -> "Two pilots options: fixed-fee 8-week sandbox (includes integration + support), or usage model with a small onboarding fee. I'll scope both and include acceptance criteria tied to KPIs above."
- "We can't integrate with Cerner easily" -> "Start with a lightweight export (SFTP or synthetic stream) for sandbox; later replace with webhook. Offer SDK snippets and a temp adaptor our solutions eng can deploy."

Notes for demo content (if we get a slot)
- Show private deployment architecture diagram (VPC peering, KMS, Splunk export).
- Live example: de-identified message -> structured summary (bullets + confidence).
- Rollout demo: how to pin model version, canary traffic split, automatic fallback to baseline model.
- Cost talk: show cost tradeoffs (dedicated vs private vs hosted) for their projected volume (estimate: 2000 triage messages/week).

Pricing roughness (to refine with finance)
- Option A: Fixed pilot (8 weeks) — $60k includes 2 engineers for integration + 1 solutions eng + support, infra costs included (private infra amortized).
- Option B: Usage-first — $10k onboarding + usage at $0.XX/token equivalent (need to model messages -> tokens).
- Need to validate with sales ops and legal — don't give firm numbers until I confirm infra delta for private deployment.

Open questions / TODOs
- [ ] Confirm sample message schema from Cerner (ask Ben).
- [ ] Quick cost calc for 2k messages/week under: quantized 8-bit model vs full fp16 (get numbers from Harpreet).
- [ ] Draft BAA + SOW template for clinical pilot (legal to review).
- [ ] Prepare short security pack PDF (controls, threat model, pen test approach).
- [ ] Build tiny demo dataset (10 de-id patient messages) and a script to show acceptance flow.

Meeting prep notes for intro call (20 min)
- 0-3m: Intros (who's on the call).
- 3-8m: Their biggest pain w/ triage/charting today (Elaine + clinicians).
- 8-12m: Quick pitch of pilot (architecture + what we keep inside VPC).
- 12-16m: Walk through KPIs + acceptance criteria.
- 16-20m: Next steps (SOW, technical contacts, timeline).

Tone & ask for first email: small ask (20-min call) + security-first posture + offer to send SOW template and security checklist.

Scratchy closing thought: focus on quick wins (triage drafts) — it's lower-risk and visible to nurses who will adopt faster. If that goes well, scaling to pre-visit summarization (which touches clinician notes) is next. 

-- end of scratchpad --

Notes to self: keep this lightweight and very concrete. Push procurement to accept fixed-scope pilot so we can control perimeter and timeline.
